plugins.name: fact-checker
plugins.changelog: v1.4.1: Claude 4.7+ temperature fix + dependency bootstrap. Every Anthropic call hard-failed with litellm.UnsupportedParamsError because triage sent temperature=0.3 and Claude Opus 4.7 and newer accept only temperature=1 (claude-opus-5, sonnet-5, fable-5, opus-4-8, opus-4-7 all affected; sonnet-4-6 and older were fine). is_reasoning_model() covered o-series, gpt-5, xAI *-reasoning and Moonshot kimi>=2.5 but not Claude; new claude_version() parses (major, minor) from any Claude id (bare, dated, Bedrock- or OpenRouter-prefixed) and deliberately skips legacy claude-3-5-sonnet, so the single call site drops the parameter and Anthropic keeps max_tokens over max_completion_tokens. New scripts/bootstrap.sh makes the skill run on a clean machine: it prints one thing on stdout, the path to an interpreter that can import litellm, so callers do FACT_CHECKER_PY=$(bash bootstrap.sh). It reuses an existing environment, accepts a working global install, prefers uv and falls back to python3 -m venv, installs from requirements.txt, verifies with importlib.metadata (litellm has no __version__ attribute, and checking for one makes a working install look broken), and passes --clear so a venv whose base interpreter was pruned is rebuilt rather than failing. The environment lives in ${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-~/.cache}/fact-checker/venv, NOT the plugin directory, which is version-keyed; FACT_CHECKER_VENV overrides it. Cold build 2.8s, warm 1.1s. SKILL.md gains a Setup section as step one and tells the agent not to improvise an install. Defensive fixes ported from spec-debate v1.10.1: codex_auth_mode() no longer crashes on a non-dict auth.json, Codex JSONL parsing hardened against non-dict lines and string error fields, antigravity cost matching scoped so it cannot swallow ids like antigravity-pro. Catalog verified against live provider APIs on 2026-08-31: xAI default grok-4.5 -> grok-4.6, ZAI default glm-5.2 -> glm-5.3, gpt-5.4 and gpt-5.4-mini retired from the Codex ChatGPT lineup, litellm floor 1.98 so grok-4.6, gemini-3.7-flash and glm-5.3 price from the registry instead of the $5/$15 default. 128 tests pass. August 2026 refresh (ports spec-debate v1.10.0): non-retryable error fast-fail (deterministic 400s no longer retry 3x), Codex ChatGPT-account preflight warning + actionable hint on model rejections, new Antigravity CLI provider (antigravity/<slug>, Gemini CLI's successor after the 2026-06-18 consumer retirement), MiniMax provider, catalog refresh (gpt-5.6-sol, claude-opus-5, grok-4.5, deepseek-v4-pro, glm-5.2, kimi-k3), OPENAI_BASE_URL override warning, retry-loop refactor, litellm floor 1.96.

plugins.name: spec-debate
plugins.changelog: v1.13.0: four bugs from a real six-round debate run, plus seven defects an adversarial review found in the fixes. emit-plan truncated silently - it never checked finish_reason, so a plan hitting the output cap was written half-finished and exited 0; the observed plan ended mid-string inside a test body with no task inventory or final verification. It now detects truncation three ways, marks the file TRUNCATED and exits 1. --press did nothing in judge mode: the press user message demanded a section-by-section review while REVIEWER_SUFFIX told the system prompt to answer [AGREE] and nothing else, so a pressed judge returned a bare [AGREE] using fewer tokens than the round before. --preserve-intent guarded wording but not structure, so models replaced whole document skeletons with a generic template and dropped every finding; a structural clause plus a mechanical heading diff now catch it. Session history discarded critique prose, leaving no record of what models argued. The review then caught the first emit-plan guard condemning COMPLETE plans - it counted ``` occurrences and tested parity, which a fence inside a string literal or a four-backtick wrapper breaks - plus a token check firing on Gemini's reasoning-inclusive counts, a moved [SPEC] contradiction, heading false positives from code comments, and strip_spec_block splitting on a prose mention of the tag. Tests 245 to 275, now covering wiring: three of the four reported bugs were wiring bugs the old suite left green. Upgrade note: emit-plan can now exit 1 where it exited 0 - that means the plan is incomplete; check the code if you call it in a loop. v1.12.0: dependency bootstrap - the skill now runs on a clean machine. SKILL.md assumed a global litellm and told the agent to run python3 debate.py directly, which fails immediately without one; the agent then improvises an install and gets it wrong (one observed attempt built a working venv then declared failure because its check read litellm.__version__, which does not exist). New scripts/bootstrap.sh prints one thing on stdout - the path to an interpreter that can import litellm - and everything else to stderr, so callers do SPEC_DEBATE_PY=$(bash bootstrap.sh). It reuses an existing environment, accepts a working global install, prefers uv and falls back to python3 -m venv, installs from requirements.txt, verifies with importlib.metadata, and passes --clear so a venv whose base interpreter was removed is rebuilt rather than failing. The environment lives in ${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-~/.cache}/spec-debate/venv, NOT the plugin directory, because plugin installs are version-keyed and an environment beside the code would be rebuilt on every update; SPEC_DEBATE_VENV overrides it. Cold build 2.8s with uv, warm resolve 1.15s. v1.11.0: Claude 4.7+ temperature fix + Aug 31 2026 catalog refresh. Claude Opus 5 / Sonnet 5 / Fable 5 / Opus 4.8 / Opus 4.7 all hard-failed with litellm.UnsupportedParamsError because the debate loop sent a temperature; those models accept only temperature=1. claude_version() now parses (major, minor) from any Claude id (bare, dated, Bedrock- or OpenRouter-prefixed) so all three temperature call sites drop the parameter together, and Anthropic keeps max_tokens over max_completion_tokens. New --claude-effort flag (low/medium/high/xhigh/max): Claude 4.6+ debaters now run at effort=low via output_config.effort, measured on Opus 5 at 155s/11.1k output tokens against 360s/25.9k at Anthropic's high default (medium saves only ~10%, so it is not the useful step-down); judges in --review-only keep high. Catalog refresh verified against live provider APIs and vendor docs: added xai/grok-4.6, gemini/gemini-3.7-flash, zai/glm-5.3, zai/glm-5.3-flash, claude-opus-4-8; retired gpt-5.4 and gpt-5.4-mini from the Codex ChatGPT lineup; repriced gpt-5.6-sol $4/$20, gpt-5.6-terra $2/$12, gpt-5.6-luna $0.2/$1.2, gemini-3.6-flash $0.75/$3.75, grok-4.20-reasoning $1.25/$2.5. litellm floor 1.98. v1.10.1: defensive provider fixes ported from gtm-forge - codex_auth_mode() no longer crashes on non-dict auth.json, antigravity cost matching scoped so it cannot swallow similar model ids, Codex JSONL parsing hardened against non-dict lines and flexible error fields, Gemini CLI retirement warning prints once per process. v1.10.0: August 2026 refresh — Codex ChatGPT-account handling (fail fast on non-retryable 400s with actionable hint, preflight warning when codex/ models aren't in the ChatGPT lineup; gpt-5.3-codex retired from ChatGPT accounts), new antigravity/ provider via agy CLI (Gemini CLI's successor; consumer gemini-cli retired 2026-06-18, now warns and is dropped from auto-selection), Claude 5 catalog (claude-fable-5/opus-5/sonnet-5 + Bedrock mappings), codex gpt-5.6 examples, dead deepseek-chat alias removed, litellm floor 1.96, CLI-provider retry loops deduplicated. v1.9.1: codex review fixes — export-tasks/emit-plan token-param fix for Moonshot reasoning models (kimi-k3 default broke both), OPENAI_BASE_URL misroute warning on all litellm paths, Kimi reasoning detection anchored to version segment, o3-pro doc drift reconciled. v1.9.0: July 2026 model catalog refresh — GPT-5.6 line (sol/terra/luna), Moonshot kimi-k3 and kimi-k2.7-code (temperature detection extended), xai/grok-4.5, zai/glm-5.2, gemini-3.6-flash, MiniMax-M2.7; new provider defaults; OPENAI_BASE_URL misroute warning.

The environment lives in ${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-~/.cache}/<skill>/venv, NOT the plugin directory, because plugin installs are version-keyed. Catalog refresh verified against live provider APIs 2026-08-31: xai/grok-4.6, gemini/gemini-3.7-flash, zai/glm-5.3 and glm-5.3-flash added; gpt-5.4 and gpt-5.4-mini retired from the Codex ChatGPT lineup; litellm floor 1.98. Catalog refresh verified against live provider APIs 2026-08-31: xai/grok-4.6, gemini/gemini-3.7-flash, zai/glm-5.3 and glm-5.3-flash added; gpt-5.4 and gpt-5.4-mini retired from the Codex ChatGPT lineup; litellm floor 1.98.
